versions.title: drawgen.co as it was
versions.note: Archive of the live drawgen.co on 25 September 2026: the home page, the product page and the six industry pages, kept as full-page screenshots. Quoting for manufacturers who build to order, on a forest green and signal cyan palette, with a hero and industry headers close to tacto.ai.

versions.title: The symbol at work
versions.note: Same copy and positioning, rebuilt from the founders' Astro source. The accent moves from cyan to a signal mint in the family of the forest green; the home hero draws the logo's two planes with a quote assembling on them; the industry headers become drawing sheets with a today and with drawgen switch; every Product menu item has its own page with a live, illustrative product moment; the Industries menu carries generated industry photographs, credited in credits.json.
